payload.text: Issue 0693 (AE ISSUE:0049) for Intent 3.3.2, resuming on vc's or hv's word after the weekend. The fix is written and banked UNGATED at refs/bank/ic/install/0693-ungated-on-06cb65c54.diff (11 files, +457 -294), and its worktree is scratchpad/wt-install on 06cb65c54, never built. It contains: install decides an installed unit through payload::settle, sync's one classifier, and AlreadyInstalled is deleted; value_flags give each claude skills|subagents verb only the flags it takes, and the parse refusal names those flags and the value_refusals reason; write_copy lets the write stamp installed_at. To finish: book a gate-rust slot (no slots wait until 0692 lands), bin/devbin build all, commit in the worktree, gen_reference.sh --rev HEAD --baseline v3.3.1, the whole bin/devbin gate rust, then rebank and send vc the ref and stat.
